summary: Staff publishing opens a step-by-step wizard for audience, website and email timing, confirmation and results, with free/paid recipient targeting and independently scheduled newsletter sends.
detailed_changes: Publish uses per-channel publish targets (website, email, social placeholder) instead of relying only on the email_on_publish flag; existing posts keep their behaviour after migration (#678).

Staff Publish opens Audience → When → Confirm → Result (Social reserved for v1.34.0), keeping draft choices when leaving and returning, with nothing going live before Confirm (#679, #680, #682, #684).
Email audiences can target everyone, free members (all members) or paid members only, with recipient counts shown before send (#681).
Newsletter email can send with the post, later, or not at all; the scheduler creates the campaign when due and cancelled schedules do not send (#683).
Result shows per-channel status with Retry and Cancel (audit-logged) and share buttons that use the canonical article URL (#685).
Wizard steps support keyboard use, aria-current, visible focus and a 320px-wide layout (#686).
Feature and front-end tests cover the wizard, free/paid targeting and time-travel scheduling (#687).
Change Log Hub entry for this release (#688).
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff and admins who publish posts
Public impact: none directly (publish timing and email behaviour for new publishes)
Internal impact: deliberate multi-step publish instead of a single Publish click
